summary: Improve office risk assessment, access controls and emergency coordination. Explore this five-day training course and strengthen your workplace plans.
lede: Corporate office security and workplace safety management brings together methods for assessing office threats and hazards and coordinating practical controls. For facilities, security and occupational safety professionals, the course covers building a prioritized risk register, reviewing visitor and contractor access, and applying CPTED to reception and restricted areas. You also practise reviewing incident trends, coordinating emergency roles, and checking inspection and access-control evidence to track corrective actions and report priorities.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who coordinate everyday office protection, workplace safety, facilities and emergency readiness.
modules: CPTED for Reception and Restricted Areas
prerequisites: Working familiarity with office operations, facilities, security or workplace safety is expected. No coding or programming is required.
